sentences.en: Welcome to Speaking of Psychology, a bi-weekly podcast from the American Psychological Association.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《心理学说话》，这是一档由美国心理学协会制作的双周播客。

sentences.en: I'm your host, Caitlin Luna.
sentences.zh: 我是主持人凯特琳·卢娜。

sentences.en: The clothes we put on every day tell a story about who we are to the world and can have a major impact on our emotions and mood.
sentences.zh: 我们每天穿的衣服向世界诉说了我们是谁的故事，并且会对我们的情感和情绪产生重大影响。

sentences.en: So where does psychology fit into all this and how does it help us solve some of the biggest challenges facing the fashion industry now and in the future.
sentences.zh: 那么，心理学是如何融入这一切的？它又是如何帮助我们解决时尚行业现在以及未来面临的一些最大挑战的？

sentences.en: Our guest for this episode is Dr. Carolyn Mayer, a cognitive psychologist who created the Psychology of Fashion department at the London College of Fashion at the University
sentences.zh: 我们本期的嘉宾是卡洛琳·梅尔博士，她是一位认知心理学家，曾在伦敦艺术大学伦敦时装学院创建了

sentences.en: of Arts London, as well as an undergraduate program and two master's degree programs there.
sentences.zh: 时尚心理学系，并在该校开设了一个本科专业和两个硕士学位专业。

sentences.en: Dr. Mayer is currently a consultant for fashion brands and recently published a book called
sentences.zh: 梅尔博士目前担任时尚品牌的顾问，最近出版了一本书，书名为

sentences.en: The Psychology of Fashion.
sentences.zh: 《时尚心理学》。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Mayer.
sentences.zh: 欢迎您，梅尔博士。

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Caitlin.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，凯特琳。

sentences.en: It's a pleasure to be here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴来到这里。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: We're happy to have you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来。

sentences.en: So how did you get into this field?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是如何进入这个领域的？

sentences.en: I've always been interested in fashion and my first job was a window dresser or visual merchandiser as is known now.
sentences.zh: 我一直对时尚很感兴趣，我的第一份工作是橱窗陈列师，也就是现在所说的视觉营销师。

sentences.en: I did that for four years, absolutely loved it.
sentences.zh: 我干了四年，非常喜欢。

sentences.en: And then I did several other creative jobs, making clothes for people, making clothes for myself and so on.
sentences.zh: 后来我还做过几份其他的创意工作，比如为别人做衣服、给自己做衣服等等。

sentences.en: And then when I got into my 30s and I had three children, I decided it was time to get a degree.
sentences.zh: 然后当我三十岁出头并且有了三个孩子时，我决定是时候去拿个学位了。

sentences.en: So I did my undergraduate degree in applied psychology and computing.
sentences.zh: 于是我攻读了应用心理学与计算机的本科学位。

sentences.en: Then I did a master's in research methods.
sentences.zh: 接着我攻读了研究方法的硕士学位。

sentences.en: And then I was very fortunate to be able to have a funded PhD studentship.
sentences.zh: 后来我非常幸运地获得了带资助的博士生奖学金。

sentences.en: So after my PhD, I really wanted to work in the applied field of psychology because my PhD was so theoretical.
sentences.zh: 所以在攻读博士学位之后，因为我的博士研究非常理论化，我非常渴望从事应用心理学领域的工作。

sentences.en: And I worked for seven years in an ordinary psychology department as a senior lecturer and then became a professor.
sentences.zh: 我在一个普通的心理学系担任了七年高级讲师，后来成为了一名教授。

sentences.en: And then I was at a conference and I met somebody from London College of Fashion.
sentences.zh: 后来我去参加一个会议，遇到了伦敦时装学院的一位先生。

sentences.en: And I, when I asked him if there were any psychologists there, he said there weren't and that I should come and do a paper there.
sentences.zh: 当我问他那里是否有心理学家时，他说没有，并建议我去那里发表一篇论文。

sentences.en: And so I gave a paper at London College of Fashion on the importance of psychology for fashion.
sentences.zh: 于是我在伦敦时装学院发表了一篇关于心理学对时尚重要性的论文。

sentences.en: And I was invited back to discuss how I could bring psychology to the college.
sentences.zh: 我被邀请回去探讨如何将心理学引入该学院。

sentences.en: And that was back in 2011.
sentences.zh: 那还是在2011年。

sentences.en: I started working there in 2012 and developed the master's courses and set up the department before I left in 2017.
sentences.zh: 我于2012年开始在那里工作，在2017年离开之前，我开发了硕士课程并建立了这个系。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So you've had a lifelong interest in fashion and that became academic.
sentences.zh: 所以你对时尚有着终生的兴趣，后来它变成了学术研究。

sentences.en: And now here you are having, have set up this, this, this program at the college.
sentences.zh: 现在你来到了这里，在这个学院建立了这个，这个，这个项目。

sentences.en: That's wonderful.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: And you wrote in your book that there are very few psychologists in this field.
sentences.zh: 你在书中写到，这个领域的心理学家非常少。

sentences.en: So from your perspective, why is it important to have psychologists researching and working in the fashion industry?
sentences.zh: 那么从你的角度来看，为什么让心理学家在时尚行业进行研究和工作如此重要？

sentences.en: Well, the fashion industry is about people.
sentences.zh: 嗯，时尚行业关乎人。

sentences.en: It employs millions worldwide and everyone wears clothes.
sentences.zh: 它在全球雇用了数百万人，而且每个人都要穿衣服。

sentences.en: Clothes are the closest thing to our bodies.
sentences.zh: 衣服是我们身体最贴近的东西。

sentences.en: They're our second skin.
sentences.zh: 它们是我们的第二层皮肤。

sentences.en: And psychologists can help with lots of the issues that are known to be caused by the fashion industry.
sentences.zh: 心理学家可以帮助解决许多已知由时尚行业引发的问题。

sentences.en: So for example, the fashion industry has a poor reputation in terms of social responsibility.
sentences.zh: 比如，时尚行业在社会责任方面的声誉不佳。

sentences.en: And now coming to a head, and it's been around for decades actually, are the issues about sustainability.
sentences.zh: 而现在正走向白热化、并且实际上已经存在了几十年的问题，就是可持续性问题。

sentences.en: So the fashion industry is one of the worst industries for damaging the environment.
sentences.zh: 因此，时尚行业是破坏环境最严重的行业之一。

sentences.en: And psychologists can help with this.
sentences.zh: 心理学家可以为此提供帮助。

sentences.en: They can help the consumers change their habits through developing behavior change prograMs. They can
sentences.zh: 他们可以通过制定行为改变项目来帮助消费者改变习惯。

sentences.en: also work with employers to help them create workplaces that provide better conditions for their staff.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以与雇主合作，帮助他们创造能为员工提供更好工作条件的职场环境。

sentences.en: And they can also help in predicting demand so that there's far less waste when the items are made.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以帮助预测需求，从而在生产服装时大大减少浪费。

sentences.en: So currently, fashion forecasters tend to work on intuition, gut feeling.
sentences.zh: 因此目前，时尚预测师往往依靠直觉和本能行事。

sentences.en: Sometimes they look at historical cycles.
sentences.zh: 有时他们会查看历史周期。

sentences.en: But psychologists are well trained in data analysis, and they will be able to predict fashion trends much better using data.
sentences.zh: 但心理学家受过良好的数据分析训练，他们能够利用数据更好地预测时尚潮流。

sentences.en: And of course, there's the obvious way that psychologists can work in the fashion industry, and that's in consumer behavior.
sentences.zh: 当然，还有一种心理学家参与时尚行业的显而易见的方式，那就是消费者行为。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Consumers are becoming more and more demanding.
sentences.zh: 消费者变得越来越挑剔。

sentences.en: They are wanting more than just to be satisfied.
sentences.zh: 他们想要的不仅仅是满足。

sentences.en: Customers now have fantastic opportunities for competition, for searching online and in store.
sentences.zh: 如今的客户拥有极好的机会来进行对比，无论是在网上还是在实体店进行搜寻。

sentences.en: So the retail companies, fashion retail companies have to give consumers a fantastic experience.
sentences.zh: 所以零售公司，时尚零售公司必须为消费者提供极佳的体验。

sentences.en: And who better to help design a fantastic experience than psychologists?
sentences.zh: 还有谁比心理学家更适合帮助设计极佳的体验呢？

sentences.en: Hey, you just touched on some very interesting issues regarding overconsumption and regarding the environment.
sentences.zh: 嘿，你刚才提到了关于过度消费和环境的一些非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: So you cited an alarming statistic in your book as well about that in the U.S., about an estimated 15 million people have a spending addiction.
sentences.zh: 你在书中也引用了一个令人警觉的统计数据，即在美国，大约有1500万人患有购物成瘾症。

sentences.en: So we know that overconsumption is clearly an issue.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道，过度消费显然是一个问题。

sentences.en: How can people break the cycle and consume more responsibly?
sentences.zh: 人们如何才能打破这个循环并进行更理性的消费？

sentences.en: Well, it's a very difficult one because the way we shop becomes a habit.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个非常难解的问题，因为我们的购物方式已经变成了一种习惯。

sentences.en: And lots of us go shopping as a social pleasure, as a leisure pursuit.
sentences.zh: 我们中的很多人去购物是为了社交乐趣，作为一种闲暇消遣。

sentences.en: And so shopping becomes part of what we do, part of our identity.
sentences.zh: 因此，购物成了我们所做之事的一部分，成了我们身份的一部分。

sentences.en: And also, you know, we like novelty.
sentences.zh: 而且你知道的，我们喜欢新鲜感。

sentences.en: We like fashion.
sentences.zh: 我们喜欢时尚。

sentences.en: We want to look nice and enhance ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们想要看起来漂亮并提升自我。

sentences.en: But people can also change their habits through structured behavior change programs so they can learn to identify what are the habits,
sentences.zh: 但人们也可以通过结构化的行为改变项目来改变习惯，这样他们就能学会识别习惯是什么，

sentences.en: what are the triggers that encourage them to go out and buy more, more, more, more.
sentences.zh: 是什么触发因素促使他们出去买、买、买、买。

sentences.en: And quite often they don't wear these iteMs.
sentences.zh: 而且往往他们根本不穿这些东西。

sentences.en: And how can their habits be changed so that it's a win-win situation for them so they have more money in their pockets to enjoy experiences rather than material objects?
sentences.zh: 以及如何改变他们的习惯，让他们获得双赢的局面，从而有更多的闲钱去享受生活体验，而不是购买物质物品？

sentences.en: And they can also do good for the environment by consuming less and contributing less to the landfill problem.
sentences.zh: 他们还可以通过少消费来为环境做贡献，减少对垃圾填埋场问题的推波助澜。

sentences.en: Is this something you're working on in your consulting work?
sentences.zh: 这是你咨询工作正在致力于解决的事情吗？

sentences.en: Yes, yes.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的。

sentences.en: So I'm currently working across so many issues within the fashion industry.
sentences.zh: 所以我目前正致力于解决时尚行业内部的诸多问题。

sentences.en: And it's just such an amazing opportunity to make a really important difference globally.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此绝佳的机会，能够在全球范围内产生真正重要的影响。

sentences.en: And so, yes, changing people's habits, looking at the communication that we we put out as a business, looking at how we communicate with our staff and with our customers.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，改变人们的习惯，审视我们作为企业发布的信息，审视我们如何与员工和客户进行沟通。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So this is something that I've been doing as a consultant since 2017.
sentences.zh: 所以这是我自2017年以来一直作为顾问在做的事情。

sentences.en: Understanding that, you know, the consumers are people and they have behavior and psychologists understand behavior.
sentences.zh: 理解消费者是人，他们有行为，而心理学家理解行为。

sentences.en: So as a cognitive psychologist, looking at all the cognitive processes, you know, the way we think, the way we perceive, the way we understand the world and make sense of it,
sentences.zh: 因此，作为一名认知心理学家，审视所有的认知过程，你知道的，我们的思考方式、感知方式、理解世界并赋予其意义的方式，

sentences.en: all these things, processes that we do as human beings.
sentences.zh: 所有这些作为人类所做的事情和过程。

sentences.en: This is what psychologists can can can help the fashion industry and to be honest, all industry learn more about.
sentences.zh: 这就是心理学家可以帮助时尚行业——说实话，是帮助所有行业——了解更多的地方。

sentences.en: And you wrote a lot about fast fashion, which we've touched on as well.
sentences.zh: 你写了很多关于快时尚的内容，我们刚才也触及了这一点。

sentences.en: The environmental impacts of this and the human impacts of it, how it's created environmental and human rights probleMs.
sentences.zh: 它的环境影响和对人类的影响，它是如何造成环境和人权问题的。

sentences.en: And there has been some movement in the pot in a positive direction.
sentences.zh: 朝著积极的方向已经有一些进展了。

sentences.en: It's more awareness of this.
sentences.zh: 人们对此有了更多的意识。

sentences.en: But people are still suffering and sweatshops and landfills are still getting filled up with unused or unwanted clothing.
sentences.zh: 但人们仍在受苦，血汗工厂和垃圾填埋场依然充斥着无人问津或不需要的衣物。

sentences.en: What is needed to change this trend?
sentences.zh: 需要采取什么措施来扭转这种趋势？

sentences.en: OK, first of all, I think it's quite important that that this notion of fast fashion equals bad needs to be changed.
sentences.zh: 好的，首先，我认为非常重要的一点是，需要改变“快时尚等于坏”这种观念。

sentences.en: So lots of items which are not considered fast fashion are made in exactly the same factories under exactly the same conditions.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多不被认为是快时尚的单品，其实是在完全相同的工厂、完全相同的条件下制造出来的。

sentences.en: The problem is not with fast fashion per se.
sentences.zh: 问题本身不在于快时尚。

sentences.en: The problem is with overproduction and overconsumption that ends up in the landfill sites.
sentences.zh: 问题在于导致垃圾填埋场堆满衣物的过度生产和过度消费。

sentences.en: There are problems with with the working conditions, with abuse of the workers, with human rights, as you say.
sentences.zh: 这里存在工作条件、虐待工人、人权等方面的问题，正如你所说。

sentences.en: And these need to be addressed at the local level because the factories are typically run by people in the local communities.
sentences.zh: 这些问题需要在地方层面得到解决，因为工厂通常是由当地社区的人经营的。

sentences.en: And there is a lot of pressure on them to change.
sentences.zh: 他们面临着很大的改变压力。

sentences.en: And hopefully they will.
sentences.zh: 希望他们会有所改变。

sentences.en: When the pressure turns into voting with our wallets, which is I think we're beginning to see that people are buying less and being more mindful with what they buy.
sentences.zh: 当压力转化为用钱包投票——我认为我们已经开始看到人们在减少购买并在购买时更加用心——

sentences.en: Then then the behavior of the factory owners and the retail companies will change accordingly.
sentences.zh: 那么工厂老板和零售公司的行为就会随之改变。

sentences.en: And the pressure is coming from consumers now.
sentences.zh: 压力现在正来自消费者。

sentences.en: So you are seeing changes in the opposite direction where people are being more mindful about what they purchase and how much of it.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到了相反方向的变化，人们对他们购买的东西以及购买的数量变得更加慎重。

sentences.en: Some pockets of the of the population, yes, for sure.
sentences.zh: 人口中的某些部分确实如此，肯定的。

sentences.en: But there are still people who want to consume a lot simply because it's cheap.
sentences.zh: 但仍然有些人想要大量消费，仅仅因为便宜。

sentences.en: And in reality,
sentences.zh: 而实际上，

sentences.en: they probably spend as much as they would on five or six very cheap items as if they as they would if they bought one more one expensive item or more expensive item that they would actually wear.
sentences.zh: 他们买五六件非常便宜的衣服所花的钱，可能跟他们买一件他们真正会穿的、更昂贵或质量更好的衣服花的钱一样多。

sentences.en: And it would potentially last longer and they would value it more.
sentences.zh: 而且这件衣服可能更耐穿，他们也会更珍惜它。

sentences.en: Do you think a solution is for people to purchase perhaps higher quality items?
sentences.zh: 你认为解决方案是让人门去购买或许质量更高的物品吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes that can mean more expensive items as opposed to those, you know, buying five T-shirts for the price of one nice shirt.
sentences.zh: 有时这意味着购买更昂贵的物品，而不是那种花一件好衬衫的钱去买五件T恤的做法。

sentences.en: Is that one way to alleviate the problem?
sentences.zh: 这是缓解这个问题的一种方法吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I think I think that makes perfect sense because, you know, buying five of very similar items and four of them are unlikely to be worn is purely wasteful.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这完全合乎情理，因为你知道，买五件非常相似的物品而其中四件很可能不会穿，纯粹是浪费。

sentences.en: And because they're cheap, they're probably not going to be sold or swapped or nobody is really going to want them secondhand anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且因为它们很便宜，所以可能不会被转卖或交换，而且无论如何也没有人真的想要二手货。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I would definitely say buy less, buy mindfully, enjoy the experience, but don't buy multiple items that you're not going to wear.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我绝对会说：少买，精明地买，享受这个过程，但不要买多件你根本不会穿的衣服。

sentences.en: And think about it at the point of sale.
sentences.zh: 要在购买时考虑清楚。

sentences.en: When are you going to wear this item or these items?
sentences.zh: 你打算什么时候穿这件或这些衣服？

sentences.en: Do you really want to buy it?
sentences.zh: 你真的想买它吗？

sentences.en: And is it just going to hang in your wardrobe with the tag still on it until you decide you don't want it anymore and find out that nobody else does either,
sentences.zh: 它是不是只会挂在你的衣柜里，吊牌都还没摘，直到你决定不再想要它，却发现别人也同样不想要，

sentences.en: which is just so wasteful?
sentences.zh: 这实在是太浪费了？

sentences.en: So there does come a point in the life cycle of a piece of clothing item where you might want to give it away or to donate it or something of that nature.
sentences.zh: 因此，在衣物的生命周期中确实会到一个时间点，你可能会想要送人、捐赠或做类似的处理。

sentences.en: Is that a good solution to to give away your clothes, give them to charity, give them to friends?
sentences.zh: 把衣服送人、捐给慈善机构、送给朋友，这是一个好办法吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是的。

sentences.en: Anything that stops them going into landfill is good.
sentences.zh: 任何能阻止它们进入垃圾填埋场的事情都是好事。

sentences.en: Recycling, if a product can be recycled, then fantastic.
sentences.zh: 回收利用，如果一件产品可以被回收，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: Sometimes the recycling process does quite a lot of harm to the environment as well.
sentences.zh: 有时回收过程对环境也会造成相当大的破坏。

sentences.en: Separating different fabrics, different textiles is difficult and not always possible.
sentences.zh: 将不同的面料和纺织品分离开来很困难，并不总是能做到。

sentences.en: But anything is better than putting your unwanted items in the bin that would go to landfill.
sentences.zh: 但任何做法都比把不需要的物品扔进通往垃圾填埋场的垃圾桶要好。

sentences.en: So swapping, renting clothes is becoming more and more popular.
sentences.zh: 所以交换、租衣变得越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: Selling on a market individual, selling their own clothes is also becoming popular.
sentences.zh: 在市场上转卖、个人出售自己的旧衣也变得流行起来。

sentences.en: And lots of fashion brands, fast fashion, I'm well aware of, I'm not sure that the higher end of the fashion market does this,
sentences.zh: 而且许多快时尚品牌，据我所知——我不确定高端时尚市场是否这么做——

sentences.en: is accepting bags of recycled, well, clothes that you don't want, previously loved clothes, let's say, for recycling.
sentences.zh: 都在接受用于回收的成袋回收衣物，好吧，就是你不想要的衣物，可以说是深受欢迎的旧衣。

sentences.en: And they might be used if they can be separated out for recycling.
sentences.zh: 如果能把它们挑拣出来，它们可能会被用于回收利用。

sentences.en: Some are used for stuffing other fabrics, for rags.
sentences.zh: 有些被用作填充其他织物的材料，或用来做抹布。

sentences.en: And then some are sent on to other countries.
sentences.zh: 然后有些被运往其他国家。

sentences.en: So there's some organizations that go around and buy unwanted used clothing.
sentences.zh: 因此，有一些组织四处奔走，收购不需要的旧衣。

sentences.en: But this can be problematic because the used clothes might end up actually frustrating the development of the fashion industry in developing markets.
sentences.zh: 但这可能会带来问题，因为这些旧衣实际上可能会阻碍发展中市场时尚产业的发展。

sentences.en: I want to turn now to mental health.
sentences.zh: 我现在想把话题转向心理健康。

sentences.en: And as you mentioned, clothing conveys a lot about a person.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，衣物传达了关于一个人的很多信息。

sentences.en: So what does, how does what we put on our bodies every day influence our mental health?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们每天穿在身上的衣服是如何影响我们的心理健康的？

sentences.en: Well, it's stressful for us if we don't feel comfortable in what we're wearing,
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果我们对自己穿的衣服感到不舒服，

sentences.en: if we're really worrying that it's appropriate or it's suitable or we don't feel confident in what we're wearing.
sentences.zh: 如果我们真的很担心它是否得体、是否合适，或者对自己的着装缺乏自信，这会给我们带来压力。

sentences.en: It stresses us.
sentences.zh: 这会让我们感到压力山大。

sentences.en: And this means that we don't have the cognitive capacity to deal with the problem at hand.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们没有认知能力来处理手头的问题。

sentences.en: This is why lots of very successful people tend to wear a work uniform, in inverted commas,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么许多非常成功的人倾向于穿所谓的“工作制服”——加引号的，

sentences.en: not necessarily a suit, but it may be a T-shirt and jeans, as we've seen with Mark Zuckerberg,
sentences.zh: 不一定是西装，但可能是T恤加牛仔裤，正如我们在马克·扎克伯格身上看到的，

sentences.en: who wears the same items every day to allow this freeing up of cognitive capacity for more important issues.
sentences.zh: 他每天都穿同样的衣服，以便解放认知能力去应对更重要的问题。

sentences.en: And then, you know, for you or me, this might mean going to a meeting wearing something that we've worn before
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，对于你我来说，这可能意味着穿着我们以前穿过的衣服去开会，

sentences.en: and knowing that it's suitable or it's appropriate and we don't have to worry about that at that time.
sentences.zh: 并且知道它是得体或合适的，我们在那个时候就不必为此担忧了。

sentences.en: I know there have been positive steps in the right direction, but it still seems like everywhere we go, we're bombarded with images that encourage us to consume fashion
sentences.zh: 我知道朝著正确的方向已经有了积极的步骤，但似乎无论我们走到哪里，我们仍然轰炸式地接收到鼓励我们消费时尚的图像，

sentences.en: and that there's no way to escape it.
sentences.zh: 并且根本无处可逃。

sentences.en: How does that impact people's mental health?
sentences.zh: 这对人们的心理健康有什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, people generally buy far more than they need and probably, to be honest, none of us probably needs to buy any more clothes ever.
sentences.zh: 嗯，人们通常买得远超所需，老实说，可能我们没有一个人需要再买任何新衣服了。

sentences.en: Research suggests that 80% of clothes in our wardrobe is unworn and that's quite worrying, actually.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，我们衣橱里80%的衣服从未穿过，这其实挺让人担忧的。

sentences.en: And some people can become addicted to shopping and this can result in debt, in shame and guilt.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能会对购物上瘾，这会导致负债、羞耻感和内疚感。

sentences.en: And there's a move now to buy mindfully, which we've discussed.
sentences.zh: 现在有一种理性消费的趋势，我们之前也讨论过。

sentences.en: And I would definitely agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我绝对赞同这一点。

sentences.en: Buying too much is something that we really should avoid.
sentences.zh: 买得太多确实是我们应该避免的事情。

sentences.en: When you buy less, it seems like a win-win situation.
sentences.zh: 当你买得少时，这似乎是一个双赢的局面。

sentences.en: You've got more money in your pocket to enjoy the experiences that bring more and lasting satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 你口袋里有了更多的钱去享受那些带来更多、持久满足感的体验。

sentences.en: And you're also doing less harm to the environment.
sentences.zh: 而且你对环境造成的破坏也更小了。

sentences.en: So throughout this interview, you've mentioned several times about the importance of people being mindful of their purchases.
sentences.zh: 所以在这次采访中，你多次提到人们对自己的购买行为保持理性意识的重要性。

sentences.en: And this move toward mindfulness is certainly wonderful in many ways.
sentences.zh: 这种走向理性意识的趋势在很多方面无疑是极好的。

sentences.en: But how does that work within the fashion industry?
sentences.zh: 但这在时尚行业内部是如何运作的呢？

sentences.en: Because they certainly need to generate profits.
sentences.zh: 因为他们显然需要创造利润。

sentences.en: I mean, they want to respond to their customers in terms of wanting to be understanding and receptive to being more mindful about fashion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们希望在客户想要对时尚有更多理性认知、并展现出理解和接受的意愿时，去回应客户的需求。

sentences.en: But at the same time, they also need to make money.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，他们也需要赚钱。

sentences.en: So what are you seeing in terms of that tension that exists?
sentences.zh: 那么，你如何看待这种现存的张力？

sentences.en: Well, I think once the fashion industry is more in tune with what their customers want, actually want, rather than what they think they want,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为一旦时尚行业更能契合客户的真实需求——他们真正想要的，而不是他们以为自己想要的——

sentences.en: when they're more able to predict more accurately, so production on demand rather than full supply,
sentences.zh: 当他们能够更准确地预测时，也就是按需生产而不是满负荷供应，

sentences.en: then, you know, this affects profits more so than the selling.
sentences.zh: 那么，你知道的，这对利润的影响比销售本身还要大。

sentences.en: So much money is wasted on overproduction.
sentences.zh: 大量的资金都浪费在过度生产上了。

sentences.en: So if that comes out of the equation, a company can still be profitable.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果把这部分去掉，公司依然可以盈利。

sentences.en: You mentioned in your book the pressure to produce for consumers is so high that people in the fashion industry often suffer from mental health issues like substance abuse,
sentences.zh: 你在书中提到，来自消费者的生产压力如此巨大，以至于时尚界的人们经常遭受心理健康问题的困扰，比如药物滥用、

sentences.en: anxiety, depression, and eating disorders.
sentences.zh: 焦虑、抑郁和饮食失调。

sentences.en: So what needs to change in the industry?
sentences.zh: 那么这个行业需要改变什么？

sentences.en: And are you seeing any movement in that direction, in a better direction?
sentences.zh: 你看到这方面有什么改变的迹象吗，朝着更好的方向发展？

sentences.en: Well, I think we're still waiting for some change in that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们仍在等待这方面的某些改变。

sentences.en: I mean, the cycles of fashion have become shorter and shorter.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，时尚的周期变得越来越短。

sentences.en: So where there used to be two seasons and perhaps a cruise collection, there are now six, seven, ten.
sentences.zh: 所以，过去通常只有两个季节，可能还有一个早春度假系列，现在却有六个、七个、十个。

sentences.en: Some high street brands have new stock every week, some every two weeks.
sentences.zh: 一些高街品牌每周都有新货，有些每两周就有。

sentences.en: And the designers are just on a treadmill.
sentences.zh: 而设计师们就像在跑步机上一样停不下来。

sentences.en: And the ones who we've seen are the very famous high-end designers where it makes news when they have mental health problems or worse.
sentences.zh: 我们所看到的是那些非常著名的高端设计师，当他们出现心理健康问题或更糟糕的情况时，会成为新闻。

sentences.en: But there's a whole industry behind them of designers' assistants and interns who don't make that publicity when they have mental health probleMs.
sentences.zh: 但在他们身后还有整个行业的设计师助理和实习生，当他们出现心理健康问题时，并没有获得这样的公众关注。

sentences.en: And it's not – there isn't time to speak out about how you feel.
sentences.zh: 而且没有——没有时间去倾诉你的感受。

sentences.en: There isn't that possibility, really.
sentences.zh: 真的没有那种可能性。

sentences.en: And it's not just the designers.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是设计师。

sentences.en: It's models as well who, when there's a fashion week or on shoots, they have to be available from the early morning to late at night,
sentences.zh: 还有模特，在时装周期间或拍摄时，他们必须从早到晚随叫随到，

sentences.en: looking fantastic the whole time, often no time to eat or very little time to eat, no food available for them.
sentences.zh: 全天候保持完美的状态，通常没有时间吃饭或只有极少的时间吃饭，也没有食物提供给他们。

sentences.en: And there are reports of models saying that they've not been treated very well at all, that they're just treated like a clothes hanger, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 有报道称，模特们说他们根本没有得到很好的对待，我想，他们只是被当作衣架对待。

sentences.en: And they're not called by their names.
sentences.zh: 而且人们不叫他们的名字。

sentences.en: Not all.
sentences.zh: 并非所有人都是如此。

sentences.en: And we see the very famous ones, the ones who have fantastic lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了那些非常有名、拥有令人艳羡的生活方式的模特。

sentences.en: But again, there are thousands of models who don't enjoy that kind of celebrity status, whose mental health may well suffer.
sentences.zh: 但同样地，还有成千上万没有享有这种名流地位的模特，她们的心理健康很可能会受到损害。

sentences.en: And it may be that the fashion industry attracts people who are susceptible to mental health problems because it's so creative, so dynamic, so exciting.
sentences.zh: 而且可能是因为时尚行业极具创造力、活力和吸引力，所以它吸引了那些容易出现心理健康问题的人。

sentences.en: And the pressures are on not just to work, but to be on form 24-7.
sentences.zh: 不仅要工作，而且承受着全天候保持最佳状态的压力。

sentences.en: And on the flip side, for consumers who see images of these impossibly thin and beautiful models,
sentences.zh: 反过来看，对于那些看到这些瘦得不可思议且美得不真实的模特照片的消费者来说，

sentences.en: what does that do to a person's self-image and their positive feelings about themselves?
sentences.zh: 这会对一个人的自我形象以及对自己的积极感受产生什么影响？

sentences.en: Well, there's quite a lot of research now which shows that even a very brief look at fashion imagery of thin models or airbrush models can damage a person's body satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在有很多研究表明，哪怕只是极其短暂地看一眼瘦削模特或精修过的时尚图像，也会损害一个人对身体的满意度。

sentences.en: So they feel worse about their body than they did before after a very brief exposure.
sentences.zh: 因此，在短暂接触之后，她们对自己的身体感觉比之前更差了。

sentences.en: And given that we're exposed to images of fashion thousands of times in a week, you know, this is affecting most of us.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我们每周都要接触数千次时尚图片，你知道的，这正在影响着我们大多数人。

sentences.en: And social media has a lot to answer for, to be honest, with the images that are on Instagram, for example.
sentences.zh: 说实话，社交媒体对此难辞其咎，比如Instagram上的那些照片。

sentences.en: So anyone who likes fashion is going to be following the people, the designers they like, the models they like, the influencers they like on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 所以任何喜欢时尚的人都会在Instagram上关注他们喜欢的人、喜欢的设计师、喜欢的模特、喜欢的网红。

sentences.en: And most of them have a particular image which the, you know, individuals want to aspire to.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数都有一个特定的形象，你知道的，这是个人想要效仿的。

sentences.en: They aspire to it, but quite often are unattainable.
sentences.zh: 他们渴望达到这种形象，但往往是无法企及的。

sentences.en: And what do you think needs to change in this area?
sentences.zh: 你认为这个领域需要改变什么？

sentences.en: Well, same as across the whole industry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，和整个行业一样。

sentences.en: More diversity, more representation.
sentences.zh: 更多的多元化，更多的代表性。

sentences.en: So not just on the other side of the camera, but in front of the camera.
sentences.zh: 所以不仅要在镜头背后，还要在镜头前。

sentences.en: So more diversity in the workforce of the fashion industry and in the peripheral workforce.
sentences.zh: 因此，时尚行业的员工队伍以及周边工作人员应该具有更多元化。

sentences.en: So model agents and so on.
sentences.zh: 比如模特经纪人等等。

sentences.en: So far more representation of the populations that the fashion industry serves.
sentences.zh: 因此，要更好地代表时尚行业所服务的群体。

sentences.en: And this isn't just about skin tone.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅关乎肤色。

sentences.en: It's about body type, body shape, ages, ability.
sentences.zh: 还关乎体型、身材、年龄、能力。

sentences.en: Just the whole range.
sentences.zh: 也就是全方位的代表。

sentences.en: You know, as I said, right at the start, everyone wears clothes.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像我一开始说的，每个人都穿衣服。

sentences.en: And everyone should be represented by the fashion industry.
sentences.zh: 每个人都应该在时尚行业中得到代表。

sentences.en: Where do you see psychologists fitting into all this in terms of helping promote more inclusivity and diversity?
sentences.zh: 在促进更多的包容性和多元化方面，你认为心理学家在其中扮演什么角色？

sentences.en: Psychologists can run studies that test hypotheses that say that improving representation is good for the industry and good for the consumer and show the evidence,
sentences.zh: 心理学家可以开展研究来检验假设，证明提高代表性对行业好、对消费者好，并展示证据，

sentences.en: bring the evidence to the fashion industries.
sentences.zh: 把证据带给时尚行业。

sentences.en: Psychologists can also help with the communities who are marginalized.
sentences.zh: 心理学家还可以帮助被边缘化的群体。

sentences.en: And when psychologists work in the industry, they can actually really show the industry and how beneficial it is to have a diverse workforce.
sentences.zh: 当心理学家在业内工作时，他们实际上可以向行业展示拥有多元化员工队伍是多么有益。

sentences.en: I mean, there's plenty of evidence for that already.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这方面已经有很多证据了。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: And turning to a more casual topic, what are your thoughts today about people dressing more casually?
sentences.zh: 转到一个更轻松的话题，你今天对人们穿着更加休闲有什么看法？

sentences.en: I mean, a lot of people wear active wear as everyday clothing and offices are becoming more casual in a lot of instances.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，很多人把运动休闲装当成日常服装，而且在很多情况下，办公室的着装也变得越来越随意。

sentences.en: Yeah, I'm fine with that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我对此觉得很自然。

sentences.en: I, you know, in London, you can wear absolutely anything you want and nobody looks at all.
sentences.zh: 我，你知道的，在伦敦，你想穿什么完全都可以，根本没人会看你一眼。

sentences.en: I think it's great that people can wear whatever they want, whether that's active wear or casual wear to work.
sentences.zh: 我觉得人们可以穿自己想穿的衣服这很好，无论是运动装还是休闲装去上班。

sentences.en: I think it's a really positive move.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个非常积极的转变。

sentences.en: For lots of people, working in a formal suit doesn't represent their true selves or their self-identity.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，穿着正式西装工作并不能代表他们真正的自我或自我认同。

sentences.en: And so they might struggle to do the kind of job that they want to if they were free to choose what clothes they can wear.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果他们可以自由选择穿什么衣服，他们可能就更能在想从事的工作上做得出色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Me, for example, I really don't like wearing suits and I would typically wear jeans.
sentences.zh: 比如我，我真的不喜欢穿西装，我通常会穿牛仔裤。

sentences.en: I'm wearing jeans now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就穿着牛仔裤。

sentences.en: Jeans and a jumper or jeans and a shirt.
sentences.zh: 牛仔裤配毛衣，或者牛仔裤配衬衫。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I think people should be allowed to dress in the way they want because the way we dress is part of our identity, part of who we are.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我认为应该允许人们按照自己想要的方式着装，因为我们的着装方式是我们身份的一部分，是我们是谁的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah, so what you're saying is a more casual environment overall does help people's mental health, I imagine,
sentences.zh: 是的，所以你的意思是，总体而言，更休闲的环境确实有助于人们的心理健康，我猜，

sentences.en: because if they're becoming more of an show expressing their authentic self as opposed to wearing a suit or uniform every day.
sentences.zh: 因为相比每天穿西装或制服，他们更能展现出真实的自我。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Probably feeling better.
sentences.zh: 可能会感觉更好。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: They have the freedom to choose and autonomy.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有选择的自由和自主权。

sentences.en: Again, plenty of evidence to support this, giving people autonomy at work or in their lives in whichever aspects is possible is a really positive element of people's life.
sentences.zh: 同样，有很多证据支持这一点，在工作中或生活的各个方面尽可能给人以自主权，是人们生活中非常积极的一个要素。

sentences.en: So people say often dress for success.
sentences.zh: 所以人们常说“衣着成功”。

sentences.en: Does that hold water these days?
sentences.zh: 如今这还说得通吗？

sentences.en: It depends on the industry, progressive industries, success might be a pair of jeans and a cool T-shirt with a slogan or something.
sentences.zh: 这取决于行业，在进取型的行业里，“成功”可能是一条牛仔裤搭配一件印有标语的酷炫T恤之类。

sentences.en: Still in finance, it might be that you still have to wear a suit.
sentences.zh: 而在金融行业，可能仍然需要你穿西装。

sentences.en: When people ask me this question, I would always say do some homework, find out what the next level in the hierarchy is wearing.
sentences.zh: 当人们问我这个问题时，我总是会说做一下功课，看看阶梯上的下一级都在穿什么。

sentences.en: What is the unwritten rule for that job?
sentences.zh: 那份工作不成文的规则是什么？

sentences.en: Because, you know, if something is inappropriate or just considered not suitable by the person who might be hiring you, then however much you love it, it shows your identity.
sentences.zh: 因为，你知道的，如果某些穿着被可能雇用你的人认为是不合适的或不体面的，那么无论你多么喜欢它、它多么能展现你的个性，

sentences.en: The person, the hirer might believe that you're not really the right person for that job.
sentences.zh: 招聘你的人可能会认为你并不真正适合那份工作。

sentences.en: In my opinion, it shouldn't matter, but it still does.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这本不该重要，但它依然很重要。

sentences.en: As a fashion psychologist, how do you approach your wardrobe?
sentences.zh: 作为一名时尚心理学家，你是如何看待自己的衣橱的？

sentences.en: I like very plain, casual clothes.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢非常朴素、休闲的衣服。

sentences.en: I try to dress appropriately for a situation that I'm going to.
sentences.zh: 我尽量根据我要去的场合进行得体的着装。

sentences.en: Yeah, I would say that I don't want clothes that shout.
sentences.zh: 是的，我会说我不想穿那种引人注目的衣服。

sentences.en: So I prefer clothes that don't say very much about them.
sentences.zh: 所以我更喜欢那些本身表达不多的衣服。

sentences.en: So I'm not a logo wearer.
sentences.zh: 所以我不是个穿着带有显著Logo服装的人。

sentences.en: Yeah, typically quite plain clothes.
sentences.zh: 是的，通常是非常朴素的衣服。

sentences.en: Often black or navy.
sentences.zh: 通常是黑色或海军蓝。

sentences.en: In the summer, maybe white.
sentences.zh: 夏天的话，可能是白色。

sentences.en: So I'm quite a plain dresser.
sentences.zh: 所以我的穿着相当朴素。

sentences.en: You know, I've actually noticed that some of the biggest fashion designers, you know, will come out on the catwalk and they're wearing very simple, maybe black clothing.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我实际上注意到一些最大的时尚设计师，你知道的，当他们出现在T台上时，穿着非常简单，也许是黑色的衣服。

sentences.en: So is there any, is there any psychological reason why, why they might do that?
sentences.zh: 那么，这背后有什么心理原因吗？

sentences.en: Are they trying to have an emphasis be on the clothes of their other clothes they're, they're designing?
sentences.zh: 他们是想把重点放在他们设计的其他服装上吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's, it's almost an unwritten rule.
sentences.zh: 是的，这几乎成了一个不成文的规则。

sentences.en: I think of the fashion industry is black, um, almost like a modest dressing, quite loose, uh, fluid, gender fluid clothes.
sentences.zh: 我认为时尚界普遍是黑色的，嗯，几乎就像是朴素的着装，相当宽松、流畅、性别模糊的服装。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, and that's been around for quite a while in the industry.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，这种风格在这个行业已经存在一段时间了。

sentences.en: Um, yeah, I, I suppose it varies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，我想这也有所不同。

sentences.en: I mean, there are some fashion designers who dress quite, um, well, outrageously, let's say.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有些时尚设计师的穿着相当，嗯，怎么说呢，相当标新立异。

sentences.en: Um, but yeah, the majority, I would say, dress plainly.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我会说大多数人穿着都很朴素。

sentences.en: Perhaps, yes, as you say, to not distract from the creations they've made that are on the catwalk.
sentences.zh: 也许，正如你所说，是为了不分散人们对T台上他们创作的作品的注意力。

sentences.en: It's always kind of struck me as, is interesting.
sentences.zh: 我一直觉得这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: Someone who creates this like nearly dynamic outfit, maybe it's colorful or something, and then comes out and they're wearing maybe a black pants and a black shirt,
sentences.zh: 某人创作了如此近乎充满活力的服装，也许色彩缤纷什么的，然后走出来时却穿着黑色的裤子和黑色的衬衫，

sentences.en: sneakers or something like that.
sentences.zh: 运动鞋之类的。

sentences.en: It's always, oh, it's a little jarring.
sentences.zh: 这总是让人，哦，觉得有点不搭调。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: All right,
sentences.zh: 好的，

sentences.en: I wanted to go back what you mentioned about the workplace uniform and kind of the trend you might see like in the Silicon Valley or something where entrepreneurs wear casual clothes.
sentences.zh: 我想回到你之前提到的工作场所制服，以及你在硅谷或类似地方可能看到的某种趋势，那里的企业家们穿着休闲装。

sentences.en: Maybe they wear the same thing every day, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 也许他们每天穿同样的衣服，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Um, is there anything behind that?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这背后有什么原因吗？

sentences.en: You mentioned people wanting to reserve cognitive resources, but is there any other, are there any psychological reasons why someone might want to wear a self-imposed uniform?
sentences.zh: 你提到人们想要保留认知资源，但除此之外还有什么其他原因吗？有什么心理原因让某人想要穿自我强加的制服吗？

sentences.en: It says something to the people who they are interacting with, for example.
sentences.zh: 例如，这向他们互动的人传达了某种信息。

sentences.en: There's not going to be any commentary around their clothes if they wear the same thing every day.
sentences.zh: 如果他们每天穿同样的衣服，就不会有关于他们衣着的议论。

sentences.en: So, you know, this issue with, oh, wow, drawing attention to what they're wearing just won't happen if you wear the same thing every day.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果你每天穿同样的衣服，“哇，看他们在穿什么”这种吸引眼球的麻烦就不会发生。

sentences.en: And perhaps that's why fashion designers and people who work in fashion wear a lot of black loose clothing because it doesn't say anything much about what they're wearing.
sentences.zh: 也许这就是为什么时尚设计师和时尚从业者穿很多黑色宽松衣服的原因，因为它们对你穿什么并没有表达太多。

sentences.en: Um, but I think there's a, an important part about the cognitive resources, because if you're stressed about what you're wearing or if you're thinking about what you're wearing,
sentences.zh: 嗯，但我认为关于认知资源的那部分很重要，因为如果你对穿什么感到压力山大，或者如果你一直在考虑穿什么，

sentences.en: you don't have the capacity to think fully on, on the job at hand.
sentences.zh: 你就没有能力全神贯注于手头的工作。

sentences.en: You know, worrying, is it appropriate or have I dressed correctly for this meeting and then I'm going to another meeting.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，一直在担心，这样穿合适吗，或者我为这个会议的着装正确吗，然后我又要去另一个会议。

sentences.en: So I think a work uniform frees up time in the morning.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为工作制服可以腾出早上的时间。

sentences.en: You don't have to make decisions about what to wear for the day, but it's also very, um, efficient at work because you, you won't get comments on what you're wearing.
sentences.zh: 你不需要对当天穿什么做决定，而且在工作时也非常高效，因为你不会收到关于你穿着的评论。

sentences.en: Um, I think it's rare that people would say, well, you're wearing the same thing every day.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为人们会说“你每天都穿同一件衣服”这种情况是很罕见的。

sentences.en: And do you think there's a lot of, um, openings in the fashion industry for psychologists?
sentences.zh: 你认为时尚界为心理学家提供了很多，嗯，发展空间吗？

sentences.en: You mentioned wanting to get more people in the field,
sentences.zh: 你提到想要吸引更多人进入这个领域，

sentences.en: but do you think this is an area of study that you see growing in the future and opportunities for psychologists or people background in psychology or interest in psychology to find a way to use their knowledge in a,
sentences.zh: 但你认为这是一个你认为未来会有所增长的研究领域吗？对于心理学家或具有心理学背景或对心理学感兴趣的人来说，是否有机会在一个，

sentences.en: perhaps a different field?
sentences.zh: 也许是与众不同的领域中发挥他们的知识？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: That they, than they expected.
sentences.zh: 比他们预期的要好。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: I think, um, this year is a very interesting year for fashion retail.
sentences.zh: 我认为，嗯，今年对时尚零售来说是非常有趣的一年。

sentences.en: I think a lot of retailers, uh, will struggle this year with the, um, rising consumer demands and the rise in competition, um, and the rise of omni channel shopping.
sentences.zh: 我认为许多零售商，嗯，今年将在不断上升的消费者需求、日益激烈的竞争以及全渠道购物的兴起中艰难前行。

sentences.en: And so psychologists are suddenly being the, the people as well as tech people.
sentences.zh: 因此心理学家突然成为了，与科技人员并列的人选。

sentences.en: Who are necessary in the fashion industry to understand all the processes that happen in the brain, as well as all the social processes, um, that happen between people.
sentences.zh: 他们是时尚行业所必需的，用来理解大脑中发生的所有过程，以及人与人之间发生的各种社会过程，嗯。

sentences.en: So consumers, uh, fashion employees, um, and the peripheral people who work with fashion brands, but are not actually part of the brands.
sentences.zh: 因此消费者、呃，时尚从业者，嗯，以及与时尚品牌合作但并非品牌真正成员的外围人员。

sentences.en: And I think a huge opening will, um, and I think a huge opening will, will happen.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，一个巨大的契机将会，嗯，而且我认为一个巨大的契机将会，将会出现。

sentences.en: And this takes time.
sentences.zh: 而这需要时间。

sentences.en: So the courses only started recruiting in 2014, but I would say in a couple of years time, there's going to be great demand for psychologists working in the fashion industry.
sentences.zh: 所以这些课程在2014年才开始招生，但我可以说，在几年之内，时尚行业对心理学家的需求将会非常巨大。

sentences.en: And I, I, I, I really feel it's important that people who work in the fashion industry as psychologists have psychology training and don't just feel that because they're human,
sentences.zh: 而且我，我，我，我真的觉得，作为心理学家在时尚行业工作的人，必须接受过心理学训练，而不仅仅是因为他们是人类，

sentences.en: that they are psychologists.
sentences.zh: 就觉得自己是心理学家。

sentences.en: I think this is really, really important because psychologists are also trained in ethics and understanding that, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为这真的，真的很重要，因为心理学家也接受过伦理道德方面的培训，并且懂得，你知道的，

sentences.en: people are vulnerable and sort of making claims about what happens because this or that can backfire with people who, who are, um, not able to handle the outcomes of something,
sentences.zh: 人是脆弱的，并且会对发生的各种事情做出某种断言，因为这或那可能会对那些，嗯，无法承受某种结果的人产生负面影响，

sentences.en: for example.
sentences.zh: 举个例子。

sentences.en: So I'm really, um, conscious of, of some people, um, wanting to work in the fashion industry, uh, as psychologists who have little or no understanding or training of psychology.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的，嗯，意识到，有些人，嗯，想要作为心理学家在时尚行业工作，却对心理学知之甚少或根本没有理解或培训。

sentences.en: And going off what you just mentioned about, about ethics,
sentences.zh: 顺着你刚才提到的关于，关于道德规范的话题，

sentences.en: there's been some scandals from recent brands like Gucci and Prada who've had issues with race and cultural sensitivity issues.
sentences.zh: 最近一些品牌如古驰（Gucci）和普拉达（Prada）出现了一些丑闻，他们在种族和文化敏感性问题上遇到了麻烦。

sentences.en: So where, how can psychologists contribute to helping brands in this, in this manner?
sentences.zh: 那么，心理学家如何能在这方面，在这方面为品牌提供帮助呢？

sentences.en: Well, psychologists can help because they need to help brands become more diverse in the areas of design, in their thinking, in their communications,
sentences.zh: 嗯，心理学家可以提供帮助，因为他们需要协助品牌在设计领域、思维方式以及沟通方式上变得更加多元化，

sentences.en: because this is an issue of lack of diversity as much as it's an ethical issue and a racist issue.
sentences.zh: 因为这既是一个缺乏多元化的问题，也是一个伦理道德问题和一个种族主义问题。

sentences.en: So the lack of awareness by these brands is clearly shocking and running, um, diversity programs, implicit bias training, um, to overcome the biases that,
sentences.zh: 因此，这些品牌缺乏意识的现象显然令人震惊，开展，嗯，多元化项目、隐性偏见培训，嗯，以克服人们，

sentences.en: that people have and also getting people on the ground, actually working with the communities who these brands serve.
sentences.zh: 人们所拥有的偏见，同时还要让基层人员真正与这些品牌所服务的社区进行合作。

sentences.en: Um, it, it, it, it, it's beyond offensive, um, and, you know, I think the brands have to hold their hands up when they've done something that is offensive, um, you know, and it is,
sentences.zh: 嗯，这，这，这，这，这已经不仅仅是冒犯了，嗯，你知道的，我认为品牌在做出冒犯行为时必须勇于承担责任，嗯，你知道的，而且，

sentences.en: it all comes down to diversity.
sentences.zh: 这一切都归结于多元化。

sentences.en: But the, the, the ethics is across the board and it needs to be implicit in everything that a brand does.
sentences.zh: 但是，道德，道德是全方位的，它需要隐含在品牌所做的每一件事中。

sentences.en: So, um, you know, we're seeing with more data use, the, the ethics of that, um, has to be really seriously considered.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，你知道的，我们看到随着数据使用的增加，其背后的道德问题，嗯，必须得到非常严肃的考虑。

sentences.en: From your perspective, what is the future of the fashion industry?
sentences.zh: 从你的角度来看，时尚行业的未来是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think the fashion industry is going to diversify, not in terms of, only in terms of its workforce or its imagery, but in terms of, of its products,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为时尚行业将会实现多元化，不仅仅是在员工队伍或品牌形象方面，而是在产品方面，

sentences.en: in terms of its services, um, because if we really are going to be buying less and it still needs to make a profit, it needs to do that somehow.
sentences.zh: 在服务方面，嗯，因为如果我们真的要减少购买，而它仍然需要盈利，它就必须通过某种方式做到这一点。

sentences.en: I think the fashion industry is also going to need to work with other disciplines, um, it's already working with AI and tech.
sentences.zh: 我认为时尚行业还需要与其他学科合作，嗯，它已经在与人工智能和科技合作了。

sentences.en: It will be working far more with materials scientists, creating biodegradable, uh, textiles that can be woven, um, easily and laundered and cared for, but also can be, uh,
sentences.zh: 它将与材料科学家进行更多的合作，创造可生物降解的，呃，可以轻松织造、洗涤和护理的纺织品，但同时也可以，呃，

sentences.en: recycled in a way that doesn't harm the environment.
sentences.zh: 以不损害环境的方式进行回收。

sentences.en: The fashion industry will, of course, be working with more psychologists, anthropologists.
sentences.zh: 时尚行业当然会与更多的心理学家、人类学家合作。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be an industry that in the past has been very much design-based and business-based that will see, um, the necessity, like neuroscience,
sentences.zh: 我认为这个过去非常侧重于设计和商业的行业，将会看到，像神经科学一样，

sentences.en: for working with lots of different disciplines and actually appreciating the value of, of the diversity of disciplines, um, within that,
sentences.zh: 与许多不同学科合作的必要性，并且真正赞赏其中，

sentences.en: within the industry that's going to make it far richer.
sentences.zh: 行业内部学科多元化的价值，这将使它变得更加丰富多彩。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for joining us, Dr. Mayer.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢您加入我们，梅尔博士（Dr. Mayer）。

sentences.en: I really appreciate your time.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激您抽出时间。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来参加。

sentences.zh: 要了解更多关于梅尔博士的工作，请访问 www.psychology.fashion。

sentences.zh: 我们想知道您对我们节目的看法。

sentences.zh: 您可以通过电子邮件将您的评论和想法发给我，邮箱是 kluna @

sentences.zh: That's K-L-U-N-A at apa.org.

sentences.zh: 以及关于心理学实践的《进展记录》（Progress Notes）。

sentences.zh: 您可以在 iTunes、Stitcher 或任何您获取播客的地方找到我们的所有播客。

sentences.zh: 您也可以访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org，收听更多单集节目。

sentences.zh: 我是凯特琳·卢娜（Caitlin Luna），代表美国心理学协会。
